stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]货币服务企业(MSB)、支付服务提供商和电子商务平台通常每日交易量很大.这些类型的企业存在哪些风险？(选择两项.)

options.A: 这些企业都是现金密集型企业,增加了金融犯罪的风险.
options.B: 了解客户(KYC)方面存在挑战,这是因为电子商务平台面向全球客户,使得客户尽职调查变得复杂且耗费资源.
options.C: 这些企业受到严格监管,因此没有理由不合规,因为这会使它们面临制裁和罚款的风险.
options.D: 犯罪分子可以利用身份欺诈来完成KYC(了解你的客户)流程,以达到资金分层的目的.
options.E: 这些企业的结算系统不够完善,无法应对高交易量

stem_en: Money services businesses (MSBs), payment service providers, and e-commerce platforms usually have a high volume of daily transactions. What are the risks associated with these types of businesses? (Choose Two.)

options_en.A: These businesses are all cash intensive, increasing the risk of financial crime.
options_en.B: KYC challenges arise because e-commerce platforms face global customers, making customer due diligence complex and resource intensive.
options_en.C: These businesses are highly regulated and therefore have no reason to be non-compliant, as this would put them at risk of sanctions and fines.
options_en.D: Criminals can use identity fraud to complete the KYC process for layering purposes.
options_en.E: These businesses' settlement systems are not sufficiently robust to handle high transaction volumes.
